notes.title: Small Update v2
notes.content:
📜 Patch Notes:

🎧 New Sound Effects:

Added new sounds for box animations.

Reworked some hit sounds to feel heavier and more satisfying.

💥 Improved Enemy Knockback:

Enemies now get launched more noticeably upon death.

Knockback feedback has been improved for better impact feel.

📘 Mini Tutorial Popups:

Small tutorial hints added to certain areas to guide new players more effectively.

🔧 Various Small Additions and Improvements:

Multiple minor updates and quality-of-life tweaks under the hood.

notes.title: Major Patch – What's New
notes.content:
🥊 Combat Overhaul – New Boxing System!
The hand-to-hand combat system has been revamped!

Now includes 3 distinct moves

The third move is a one-hit finisher, while the other two stun the enemy

Most enemies die after just 2 clean hits 👊💥

🔫 New Weapons Added!
🦅 Deagle

🎯 Sniper Rifle

🔥 Flame Gun
...and more! Experiment with powerful new ways to fight.

🧠 New HUD System
A new weapon-shaped HUD has been introduced!
Press TAB to view your current status in style! 📊🔫

💀 New Death System
When you die, your demise is now shown on a TV screen with a variety of unique messages 📺☠️
Adds a cinematic and eerie feel to death sequences!

🚪 Door Opening Animation
Doors no longer just pop open — they now come with a satisfying opening animation 🚪✨

🛍️ Inventory & Shop System
A new shop has been added!

Buy weapons and customize your loadout, including outfits

Equip your items directly from the inventory 💼🧢

👑 Boss Scene Update
The boss scene has been updated with a new environment!
(Currently in prototype state, major upgrades coming soon!) ⚠️🧪

💵 Money System
Enemies and breakable crates now drop money!

Use your earnings in the shop to gear up faster! 🪙💸

🧩 And Much More...
This update is packed with dozens of tweaks, polish, and surprises.
Thanks for playing and supporting us — more upgrades on the way! ❤️‍🔥

notes.title: Small Patch v1.2
notes.content:
🔄 Scroll Down: Transition to boxing mode has been implemented.

⏰ No Button Press Required for Broken Clock: When we have the clock, time stops if the bullet is close, even if there is a slide cooldown.

🔍 Zoom In/Out Effect: Added in addition to the time slowdown effect.

📚 Some Tutorials Updated: We added information about switching between weapons and boxing with scroll.

🔧 Minimal Revisions.

notes.title: demo v2
notes.content:
HUD Interface: Now we can see when each skill will be available.

Bombs: Increased their speed to make them more functional. They also explode on impact when hitting doors.

Collectibles: Added a clock item—if the surroundings get dark and we press E, we can stop time, but we need the clock item to do so.

Doors: They can no longer be opened by shooting. We need explosive bullets or bombs to break them.

Adrenaline Syringe: Picking this up allows us to use explosive bullets.

New Animations & Enemy Reactions:

Headshots instantly kill.

If an enemy is shot in the chest, it takes two bullets to kill them.

A single chest shot makes them stagger back and stay stunned for a moment.

We can either finish them with a second shot or get close and press E for a finisher move.

The finisher move can also be used creatively—if an enemy is behind a door when we open it, they get stunned and we can execute a finisher.

Animations:

Added death and hit animations that include a knockback effect for better hit feedback.

Dog Tags (Collectibles): Not added yet—I need to think about how they will connect to the story.

Controls Update:

Dash is now on Right Click.

Bombs are now thrown with Shift.
